hero.title: The Story
hero.subtitle: A digitally small agency with an enormous obsession for detail.

story.title: Why We Exist
story.p1: Elyra started with a question that bothered us for a long time: why do people have to choose between a beautiful site that runs slowly, and a fast site that looks dull? Between a powerful system that intimidates its users, and an easy tool that lets its owners down?
story.p2: We decided not to choose. We design with beauty that stops the scrolling, engineer with precision that respects every millisecond, and automate whatever can be automated to give humans their time back — this is Elyra's covenant with every client.
story.p3: Today, after more than 120 projects spanning websites, platforms and automation systems, we're still the same team: small, obsessed, and asking every single time — is this more beautiful than what came before?

beauty.title: Beauty First
beauty.desc: Beauty isn't decoration — it's respect for a visitor giving you two seconds of their life. Every pixel needs a reason.

precision.title: Precision as Engineering
precision.desc: Deadlines that are honored, code that is tested, performance that is measured. Precision isn't a slogan; it's a daily operating system.

humanAutomation.title: Automation That Serves People
humanAutomation.desc: We automate routine to free time for creativity — not to replace humans, but to return them to what they do best.
